descriptions.job-068upmo:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About the Team

The Financial Crime Quality Assurance (QA) team at OKX is responsible for maintaining and enhancing the quality of financial crime investigations across the business. We are a team of risk-focused professionals who independently assess investigation quality, promote consistency in decision-making, and ensure compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and regulatory expectations. By working closely with Operations, Product, and Compliance teams, we help strengthen financial crime controls and drive continuous improvement across the investigation lifecycle.
 

About the Opportunity 

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Compliance Assurance Function of a regulated crypto business. As a QA Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting quality reviews of financial crime investigations, assessing investigator decision-making, and ensuring compliance with AML/CFT requirements, internal policies, and quality standards. You will work closely with Operations, Team Leads, and Product teams to drive continuous improvement, strengthen investigation quality, and support the effectiveness of the firm’s financial crime controls.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Quality Reviews – Conduct daily independent QA reviews of investigator and Sanctions casework, including Transaction Monitoring, Name Screening, EDD, and other AML investigations. Evaluate accuracy, completeness, adherence to AML/CFT policies, regulatory requirements, internal procedures, and the quality of case narratives. Assess whether investigative decisions are well-supported, risk-based, and appropriately documented, including escalation and disposition outcomes. Identify defects, document findings, and provide clear, constructive feedback to investigators and team leads.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration – Partner closely with the Financial Crimes Operations team, Team Leads, Product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate QA findings, discuss quality trends, resolve process gaps, and ensure consistent interpretation of policies and quality standards. Build strong relationships across AML and other cross-functional teams to support a holistic approach to compliance and risk management.
  • Quality Calibration & Internal QA Meetings – Participate in and facilitate regular QA calibration sessions to review complex or borderline cases, discuss grey areas, align on scoring methodology, and ensure consistency in quality evaluations across the QA team. Share key findings, emerging typologies, regulatory expectations, and best practices to improve review quality and reduce subjectivity.
  • Performance Monitoring & Reporting – Monitor investigator quality performance, analyze QA findings and recurring error trends, and prepare regular quality reports and dashboards. Identify systemic issues, emerging risks, root causes, and opportunities to strengthen controls and support management decision-making.
  • Coaching & Quality Improvement – Provide timely and actionable feedback to investigators and team leads to improve investigation quality, strengthen analytical skills, and enhance case documentation. Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AML investigations by providing guidance on complex or high-risk cases, typologies, and regulatory expectations. Support remediation activities by validating corrective actions and tracking quality improvements over time.
  • Policy & Process Compliance – Ensure all reviews are conducted in accordance with internal AML/CFT policies, regulatory requirements, quality frameworks, and standard operating procedures. Escalate potential compliance risks, control weaknesses, or systemic issues identified during QA reviews.
  • Continuous Improvement & QA Framework – Support continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to investigation procedures, QA methodologies, workflows, scorecards, sampling frameworks, training materials, and quality controls. Contribute to AI-enabled quality tools such as QA Copilot and participate in UAT, process validation, and implementation of new quality initiatives.
  • AML Projects & Program Enhancements – Participate in AML-related projects, initiatives, and program enhancements as required. Provide QA expertise and support cross-functional initiatives aimed at strengthening AML controls, processes, and overall program effectiveness.
  • Ad Hoc Responsibilities – Perform additional assignments and special projects as delegated by the supervisor, including process improvement initiatives, training support, root cause analysis, documentation updates, and cross-functional projects to strengthen the overall quality program.
 

What We Look For In You

  • Bachelor's degree in law, finance, business administration or a related field; a relevant compliance certification (e.g. ICA, CAMS) is an advantage
  • Prior experience in a compliance, legal or regulatory role within financial services, fintech or crypto industry is preferred
  • Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulations, financial crime investigations, transaction monitoring, and QA methodologies, with the ability to evaluate investigation quality, assess decision-making, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and quality standards
  • Strong analytical ability, with the capacity to assess regulatory obligations, identify gaps and produce well-reasoned written analysis
  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and produce consistent, high-quality documentation
  • Fluent in English with clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey compliance requirements to non-specialist colleagues
  • Strong organisational skills, able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, prioritise effectively and meet regulatory deadlines
  • Comfortable operating with limited supervision, escalating appropriately when required
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
 
OKX Statement:
OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
 
  • The salary range for this position is $107,000 - $160,000
  • The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via OKX internal or external careers site.

descriptions.job-1xukbgg:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Real Estate and Corporate Security

The Real Estate & Office Services team at Gemini is responsible for building and maintaining world-class office environments that reflect our culture, values, and operational needs. Our team ensures that each physical location supports productivity, collaboration, employee experience, safety, and business operations. We act as trusted partners and problem-solvers—creating spaces where Gemini can thrive.

The Role: Associate, Real Estate and Office Services

We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and hands-on Real Estate and Office Services Associate to support the day-to-day operations of Gemini's Arizona Operations Center and broader Real Estate & Office Services initiatives. This individual serves as the primary on-site Office Services representative and partners closely with RESO leadership, Corporate Security, IT, People, property management, and external vendors across workplace operations, facilities, physical access, space planning, office projects and moves, on-sites and events, and employee experience. 

Given the nature of our workplace and 24/7 operations, this role requires a high degree of professionalism, maturity, discretion, and security awareness. The Associate must be able to work independently while consistently following established policies, procedures, security protocols, and escalation paths.

The ideal candidate is a mature, dependable, highly professional, and service-oriented operator who takes ownership and follows through. They are proactive and capable of working independently, while respecting established processes, decision-making authority, and escalation paths. They are security-conscious, follow protocols to a T, exercise good judgment, and know when to escalate. They remain organized and professional when priorities change and can be trusted to represent Gemini appropriately with employees, visitors, vendors, and external partners.

This role is required to be in person five days per week at our Tempe, AZ (soon to be Scottsdale) office.

Responsibilities

Workplace Operations & Employee Experience 

  • Serve as the primary on-site Office Services point of contact and oversee day-to-day workplace operations. 
  • Maintain a professional, secure, organized, and employee-ready office environment, including shared spaces, pantry, supplies, mail, shipping/receiving, and workplace services.
  • Support the workplace needs of a 24/7 Operations Center, including seating, parking, access, shared spaces, and general office readiness. 
  • Support the workplace portion of employee onboarding by helping ensure desks, building access, parking, and general office readiness are coordinated with the appropriate teams.
  • Support employee on-sites, leadership visits, and office events, including rooms, catering, transportation, vendors, and related logistics. 
  • Maintain familiarity with building procedures, emergency contacts, office service schedules, and key vendor contacts to ensure continuity of local operations.

Facilities, Property Management & Vendors 

  • Serve as the day-to-day liaison with property management, building security, engineering, parking, and other building teams.
  • Coordinate building access, parking, maintenance, repairs, COIs, deliveries, vendor access, and other facilities requirements. 
  • Manage scheduling and day-to-day relationships with workplace vendors, including cleaning, pantry/beverage, furniture, moving, maintenance, shredding, and other office services.
  • Proactively identify workplace issues, track them through resolution, and escalate as appropriate. 

Space, Supplies & Inventory 

  • Maintain seating charts and coordinate desk assignments, shared seating, workstation changes, and capacity needs. 
  • Manage office furniture, supplies, and workplace inventory, including tracking, storage, and readiness. 
  • Coordinate with the appropriate internal teams when technology, security, or other specialized support is needed for the workplace. 
  • Anticipate workplace needs associated with headcount changes, onboarding, team on-sites, and operational schedules. 

Office Moves & Projects 

  • Partner with RESO leadership, Corporate Security, IT, and other stakeholders on office moves, openings, buildouts, decommissions, and workplace projects. 
  • Coordinate on-site execution, including vendors, packing, furniture, deliveries, access, employee communications, and move logistics. 
  • Track project tasks, timelines, open items, and office readiness and communicate risks or roadblocks to the appropriate stakeholders. 
  • Participate in project meetings, site walkthroughs, vendor meetings, and move-in/move-out activities as needed. 

Security & Access 

  • Partner closely with Corporate Security to administer employee badges/access, vendor and visitor access, and other physical security requirements. 
  • Maintain a security-minded approach to all workplace activities and ensure established access and security procedures are followed consistently. 
  • Follow security and operational protocols precisely; do not make exceptions or create workarounds without appropriate approval. 
  • Recognize when an issue requires escalation and engage RESO leadership, Corporate Security, People, IT, or other functional owners as appropriate. 
  • Support emergency preparedness, building incidents, and employee safety procedures in coordination with the appropriate teams. 

Administration & Cross-Functional Support 

  • Manage office-related purchasing, receipts, invoices, expenses, and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain accurate vendor, project, inventory, access, parking, and operational records.
  • Provide regular updates to RESO leadership and proactively surface upcoming needs, risks, cost-saving opportunities, or operational improvements. 
  • Partner effectively with Corporate Security, IT, People, Finance, managers, property management, and other stakeholders. 
  • Draft and distribute clear, professional workplace communications regarding office operations, building updates, access, parking, events, and other employee-facing matters, as directed by RESO leadership. 
  • Support additional RESO projects and priorities as business needs evolve.

Employee Onboarding Support

  • Support the workplace portion of employee onboarding, including coordinating desk assignments, building access, parking, and general office readiness with the appropriate internal teams.
  • Coordinate directly with new hires to provide office-specific information and ensure they understand access, parking, and arrival procedures.
  • Provide day-of onboarding support, including welcoming new hires, helping them navigate the office, directing them to their assigned workspaces, and addressing general workplace questions.
  • Partner with People, IT, Corporate Security, and hiring managers to help ensure a smooth and welcoming in-office onboarding experience.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in office services, workplace operations, facilities coordination, office management, hospitality, or a related role. 
  • High level of professionalism, maturity, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Strong security mindset and demonstrated ability to follow established policies, procedures, and protocols consistently and precisely. 
  • Ability to work independently while understanding decision-making authority, functional ownership, and when escalation or approval is required. 
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities through completion. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft clear, professional employee and vendor communications and represent Gemini appropriately with employees, leadership, vendors, and building partners. 
  • Experience coordinating vendors and working cross-functionally with teams such as IT, Security, People, and Facilities. 
  • Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace and Slack is required; experience with workplace, access control, expense, or project-management systems is a plus.
  • Comfortable with hands-on workplace responsibilities, including moving supplies, light office setup, and supporting office moves. 
  • Experience supporting a call center, operations center, or other 24/7 workplace environment is a plus.
It Pays to Work Here
 
The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:
  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.
descriptions.job-11oc4cg:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the role

We're looking for a Workplace Lead to own our physical space and what it feels like to work here. You'll report to the Head of People Experience and manage the Office Manager and Receptionist. On day one you're running NYC HQ. Over the next year you'll build the team and systems to keep it running at 200 and 500 people, and lead a major office build-out.

This is a strategic role, not an administrative one. You'll run the office like a product, constantly shipping improvements that make the space match the intensity of the work we do. You'll manage the team, the budget, and the vendors, and own how Polymarket's offices look and feel. Done well, the workplace becomes a reason people want to come in.

What you'll do

Run the office

  • Keep NYC HQ running at a high bar every day: space, supplies, furniture, and vibes

  • Set the standard. If something's broken or missing, your team fixes it before anyone notices.

  • Select and manage vendors (cleaning, catering, facilities maintenance)

  • Own the workplace budget. Plan it, track it, and find places to save.

  • Make sure investors, candidates, and partners get who Polymarket is the moment they walk in

  • Work with IT and Security on the systems behind the office (visitor management, room booking, inventory, maintenance) and keep them working as we grow

  • Make the office sustainable and accessible: sensible waste, energy, and recycling practices, and spaces that meet ADA standards and work for everyone

Own health, safety & security

  • Own workplace health and safety: routine checks, ergonomics, and local compliance

  • Run emergency preparedness with the Security team, including evacuation plans, drills, and business continuity

  • Work with Security on physical access and incident response, from building access to visitor protocols

Build and lead the team

  • Manage and grow the workplace team, starting with the Office Manager and Receptionists

  • Set clear goals and ownership, coach the team, and hold a high bar

  • Write the playbooks and SOPs so the office runs well when you're not in the room

  • Be the go-to workplace partner for People, Finance, IT, and Security

  • Track how the workplace is doing (utilization, employee satisfaction, spend) and report it to leadership

Own events & culture infrastructure

  • Own the in-office events program: happy hours, celebrations, and All Hands logistics. You set the direction; your team runs the day-of with your assistance as needed

  • Partner with People on culture programming: swag, welcome kits, recognition, onboarding, ongoing programs, and seasonal moments

  • Use the space and the calendar to keep people connected in person as we grow

Lead the workplace team through the office build-out

  • Manage the landlord relationship, for this building and future. You ensure the lease is honored, we’re compliant with local ordinances, and we maintain a strong partnership with the building and city officials

  • Work with our in-house designers and outside architects and interior teams on timeline, permitting, furniture, and the move itself. Delivering the new space on time, on budget, and with an exceptional experience for the team

  • Take on more sites and real estate as we grow, scoping and building out new space as Polymarket expands

What we're looking for

  • 7–10+ years in workplace, office operations, or facilities at a high-growth startup or tech company, including managing people

  • You've built a workplace function and led the team that runs it day to day

  • You've led a major office build-out or relocation

  • Sharp with budgets and vendors: you negotiate well and hold people accountable

  • You build durable systems instead of one-off fixes

  • Extreme ownership: when the AV dies mid-all-hands, you fix it and make sure it doesn't happen again

  • High taste and attention to detail. The office should look good and run well.

  • A strong communicator who can talk to executives, engineers, and contractors, and adjust to whoever's in the room

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or fast-moving startups

  • Experience managing office build-outs in NYC specifically

  • Event planning background, internal or external

  • Familiarity with Notion, Slack, and modern workplace tools

  • Experience partnering directly with People Ops / HR on culture programming

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup — new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories
descriptions.job-1brno1s:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct Know Your Business (KYB) reviews for corporate onboarding, including verification of corporate structures, Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) identification, and document authentication.
  • Perform Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on high-risk entities, complex corporate structures, and customers operating in regulated or sensitive industries.
  • Assess PEP exposure, sanctions risk, and adverse media across corporate hierarchies and associated individuals.
  • Execute ongoing monitoring and periodic reviews of existing corporate clients, ensuring continued compliance with risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify and escalate unusual corporate structures, nominee arrangements, shell entities, and other indicators of potential financial crime.
  • Maintain accurate and well-documented case files that clearly support risk decisions and meet audit and regulatory standards.
  • Collaborate with AML Operations, Compliance, and business teams to resolve complex onboarding cases and provide risk-based recommendations.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of KYB procedures, risk frameworks, and assessment criteria.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in KYB, KYC/CDD, corporate due diligence, or financial crime compliance.
  • Strong understanding of corporate structures, ownership chains, UBO identification, and entity verification across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated experience handling complex, high-risk, or regulated customers, including financial institutions, MSBs, funds, and trust structures.
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, sanctions regimes, and beneficial ownership transparency requirements.
  • Experience with cryptocurrency-related entities (exchanges, custodians, DeFi protocols) is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with excellent attention to detail and sound risk judgement.
  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent are advantageous.
  • Embraces AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity and streamline compliance processes.

Profile

  • Comfortable navigating complex corporate records across multiple jurisdictions and piecing together a clear picture from diverse sources.
  • High integrity with the confidence to challenge incomplete information and maintain independent risk judgement.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving regulatory expectations.
  • Strong communicator who can articulate risk clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.  Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
descriptions.job-1pmods0:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Performance marketing at Kraken is being rebuilt from the ground up. Manual bid management, creative iteration, budget allocation, and audience targeting are being replaced by agent systems that detect signals, make decisions, and execute continuously, learning from every result.

As Sr. Performance Marketing Manager, Growth Systems, you bring deep paid growth expertise and apply it to the systems replacing manual execution. Your job is to define the logic: what signals matter, what decisions should be automated, what guardrails must exist, and what the creative feedback loop looks like across paid channels. The engineers build what you spec. The agents run what you design.

While your primary focus is performance and paid growth, you will also contribute to automating other growth levers, including CRO, incentives, referrals, and cross-channel workflows, as the engine expands. The domain expertise is your anchor. The systems thinking is what scales it.

This role is for someone who has run growth at scale and found themselves constantly asking why are we doing this manually. If you've felt the ceiling of what human-operated paid growth can achieve and want to build the system that breaks through it, this is that role.

The opportunity

  • Refine creative and copy variants generated by the AI creative layer, applying domain judgment to what will perform before the data confirms it

  • QA agent outputs, review what the system produces, identify where it falls short, and define the corrections that improve it

  • Monitor workflow performance and continuously improve, this system compounds with your input, it does not run itself

  • Define and spec automation workflows for paid growth, from creative fatigue detection to budget reallocation to geo level channel mix optimization to audience signal processing

  • Work directly with the build team to translate your workflow specs into working agent automations

  • Define knowledge base inputs for the paid growth agents, what rules, guardrails, and campaign logic should be codified and kept current

  • Extend your systems thinking to other growth levers, CRO, incentives, referrals, and lifecycle, as the engine expands across growth functions

What you bring

  • 8+ years in performance or paid growth, you have run campaigns at scale across major paid channels and understand the mechanics deeply

  • Deep expertise across core paid channels (Meta, Google/YouTube, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, programmatic/DSPs) rather than just "major paid channels" generically

  • Comfort with data, you can read a performance dashboard, interpret signal from noise, and define what an agent should optimize for

  • Strong written communication, the workflow specs you write become the blueprints engineers build from. Clarity matters.

  • Systems thinking, you can map a growth workflow as a series of triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements. You think in logic, not just tactics

  • Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs

  • High agency, you define the work, you don't wait for it to be defined for you

Nice to haves

  • Experience with marketing automation, CRM, or lifecycle messaging systems

  • Exposure to A/B testing and experimentation frameworks

  • Background in fintech, consumer financial products, or regulated industries

  • Any hands-on experience with workflow automation or no-code orchestration tools

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

descriptions.job-02w9egw:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. The Executive Content & Experiences team builds trusted relationships with leaders shaping the global economy. Beyond delivering premier high-touch moments, we turn leadership insights into actionable intelligence that directly informs Stripe’s narratives, product, and go-to-market direction.

We are looking for a rock star product marketer to translate Stripe’s most complex technology and strategy into compelling, executive-ready narratives and scalable sales motions. In this role, you will lead the content strategy and enablement engine that powers our highest-stakes executive moments—from global Executive Briefing Centers (EBCs) to bespoke leadership workshops. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Executive Engagement, you will equip Stripe leaders, account teams, and event hosts to clearly articulate Stripe as the complete financial infrastructure for the internet.

Responsibilities

  • Develop Thought Leadership Narratives: Craft tailored, point-of-view-driven narratives and presentations for executive-level meetings, advisory boards, and Tier-1 convenings.

A crisp storyteller, strategic thinker, and enablement innovator. You excel at taking deep technical complexity—like global payments infrastructure and financial software—and turning it into elegant, high-impact stories for C-suite audiences.   • Bachelor's degree

There are multiple major product tracks underway: expanding PayBox across AI platforms, building peer-to-peer payment experiences, integrating with DeFi applications, growing our plugin ecosystem and significantly improving the end-to-end product experience.

We’re looking for an exceptional Staff Software Engineer to help own PayBox and take it through this next stage.

You’ll work closely with our Chief Engineer and a small, highly focused team. This is much closer to a founding engineer role than a traditional Staff engineering position. You’ll be expected to identify what matters, reason through difficult problems, make decisions and take areas of the product from idea through to production.

That could mean designing and building an entirely new PayBox capability one week and obsessing over the details of an onboarding flow the next. We care equally about ambitious technical problems and the less glamorous work required to make a product great.

We’re not looking for a specific technology or domain background. You don’t need previous crypto or MCP experience. We’re looking for an exceptional generalist engineer who can learn quickly, think independently, build end-to-end and deeply cares about what they ship.

What You Will Do

  • Own significant areas of PayBox end-to-end, from identifying the problem and defining the approach through to building, shipping and iterating in production.

  • Help take a recently launched product through its next phase of 0→1 development and growth.

  • Build new payment and peer-to-peer transfer experiences designed for AI interfaces.

  • Build integrations across AI platforms, applications and the wider PayBox ecosystem.

  • Help develop the infrastructure and product experiences required to bring new applications and integrations onto PayBox.

  • Work closely with Product to turn ambitious ideas into simple, usable experiences.

  • Sweat the details of the PayBox experience — particularly onboarding and UX — and fix the friction that prevents users from successfully using the product.

  • Reason from first principles about difficult technical and product problems, making pragmatic decisions without waiting for perfect information.

  • Move across different parts of the product and technical stack depending on where the highest-impact problem is.

  • Use AI extensively to increase your speed and output while maintaining your own technical reasoning, judgement and attention to detail.

About You

We’re deliberately not defining the ideal candidate by a particular technology stack or domain.

There are three things we care deeply about: technical ability, motivation and thoroughness. We’re looking for someone exceptional across all three.

Must-have experience and skills

  • Exceptional technical reasoning. You have strong engineering fundamentals and can break down unfamiliar, ambiguous problems and reason towards good solutions.

  • High agency. You don’t wait for perfectly defined requirements or someone else to identify what needs doing. You find important problems and take responsibility for solving them.

  • End-to-end ownership. You’ve built and shipped meaningful products, projects or systems from beginning to end rather than operating within a narrowly defined area.

  • Thoroughness. You care deeply about the quality of your work and sweat details others might overlook. Getting something working is the beginning, not the end.

  • Strong systems thinking. You can design systems, understand technical trade-offs and make sensible architectural decisions while moving quickly.

  • Product judgement. You understand that great engineering includes the experience around the technology, not just the underlying implementation.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You’re at your best in environments where there are more problems than people and priorities can change quickly.

  • Independent thinking in an AI-native environment. You use AI aggressively as a tool, but you don’t outsource your reasoning to it. You understand the output, challenge it and remain accountable for what you ship.

  • Deep motivation. You want ownership and responsibility and care about the outcome of the product, not simply completing the work assigned to you.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Experience as a founding engineer or early engineer at a high-growth startup.

  • Experience founding and building your own company or product.

  • Experience taking a product from an idea through launch and subsequent iteration.

  • Experience operating in small, highly autonomous engineering teams.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building AI-native products, agents or developer tooling.

  • Experience with payments, fintech, crypto or DeFi.

  • Previous experience with MCP or other emerging agent protocols.

None of these are prerequisites. We care considerably more about how you think, what you’ve built, how you operate and how much you care about the quality of your work.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

As part of the Bybit Card Product team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategy, roadmap, and execution of one of Bybit’s core products—the Bybit Card. In this role, you will define and build scalable payment experiences, bridging traditional financial infrastructure with cryptocurrency. While your primary focus will be on end-to-end product development and user journey optimization, you will also closely collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive acquisition, conversion, and retention. You will manage a team of up to 5 people.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the global card product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning with broader company objectives and user growth goals.

  • Define market-specific requirements and prioritize features that elevate the Bybit Card experience across multiple regions.

End-to-End Feature & Flow Design

  • Design, build, and optimize core card product flows, including application onboarding, KYC/compliance checks, digital/physical card issuance, wallet linking, and transaction experiences.

  • Drive the user experience around rewards, cashbacks, VIP tiers, and card management features to maximize user activation and retention.

Market Launches & Localization

  • Lead go-to-market (GTM) execution for new market expansions and product features, orchestrating internal testing, alpha/beta phases, and full commercial rollouts.

  • Partner with local compliance, legal, and risk teams to ensure card features adhere to regional financial regulations and card network rules.

Partner & Vendor Integration

  • Collaborate with external partners—including card schemes (Visa/Mastercard), BIN sponsors, processors, and banking partners—to build and expand technical capabilities.

  • Define requirements for platform API integrations, ledger systems, and processor hooks to support real-time settlement and authorization.

Data-Driven Optimization & Conversion

  • Define key product metrics (e.g., application conversion, active card usage, transaction volume, churn rate) and continuously optimize the user journey using product analytics.

  • Conduct user research and competitive benchmarking to identify growth opportunities and feature gaps.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Operational Alignment

  • Work closely with Card Operations, Engineering, Design, Customer Support, Risk, and Marketing to ensure seamless feature delivery and post-launch support.

  • Serve as the core product owner translating complex financial and operational realities into intuitive, user-centric product experiences.

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of product management experience in fintech, card issuing, crypto, or digital payments platforms.

  • Strong understanding of card management systems (CMS), payment processor integrations, and card network rules/ecosystems (Visa, Mastercard, etc.).

  • Proven track record of taking complex fintech or payment products from concept to launch across international markets.

  • Strong user experience (UX) mindset with an ability to simplify complex crypto and fiat payment interactions into intuitive user flows.

  • High autonomy and creative problem-solving skills; ability to make strategic decisions independently without requiring detailed top-down guidance.

  • Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required. Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is a plus.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving results across matrixed, multi-cultural teams.

  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable using data to validate hypotheses, define success metrics, and optimize transaction funnels.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.  Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
descriptions.job-0bp5wow:
About Fasset

At Fasset, we believe your money should answer to you. We are a banking and investment platform built around a simple idea: more people should have access to the financial system, regardless of where they live. We are building the global financial system for ownership, one that moves what you earn into what you own, so that what you can own is never decided by where you were born.

We operate across emerging markets, with a particular focus on the Middle East, Asia and Africa. Founded by Mohammad Raafi Hossain and Daniel Ahmed, Fasset has raised more than $80 million and holds regulatory approvals across markets including the UAE, Indonesia, Malaysia, the EU, Türkiye and Pakistan.

We are a fast-moving, global team scaling a regulated platform across multiple markets. Our culture runs on HEART: Humble Curiosity, Enthusiasm, Act Like Owners, Raise the Bar, and Tenacity. And we hold one simple view about the people who join us: the owners arrive early.

About the role

You'll own product launches, end to end.

That means the positioning brief, the plan, the dates, the cross-functional pull, and the honest read on how it performed after it shipped. You write the brief. The writing team takes it into product copy, lifecycle, and campaign surfaces. You keep the story straight across all of it.

You won't be inventing a voice. We have a brand canon and writing guidelines, and they're specific. Your job is to apply them well across markets that don't behave the same way.

What you'll do

  • Run launches end to end. Brief, plan, dates, ship, post-launch read.
  • Decide which releases get a full launch and which get a line in the changelog. Hold that bar when someone senior disagrees.
  • Write the positioning brief and message hierarchy, then stay with it through to shipped copy with the writing team.
  • Keep one plan and one set of dates across product, design, writing, growth, data, support, and the country leads.
  • Coordinate across marketing, global marketing, CRM, lifecycle and performance teams to optimize product launch
  • Work with country leads on what actually moves someone in Karachi, Dhaka, Dubai, and Jakarta, etc. One voice. Local truth.
  • Brief support, community, and country teams before launch day so they can answer accurately on day one.
  • Set the success metric before the launch. Report it after. Say so when it missed.
  • Track the competitive set locally and globally, and bring it into launch decisions while they're still open.

Must have

  • 6+ years in product marketing, including consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or investing.
  • Launches you owned yourself. Bring two and the numbers behind them.
  • Real writing ability. We'll read copy you wrote, not campaigns you approved.
  • Comfort working inside someone else's voice system and making it better from inside it.
  • You pull your own data. We use Metabase and Mixpane
  • You've shipped in more than one country and can say what changed between them.
  • You move without a large team behind you.

Nice to have

  • Urdu, Bangla, or Bahasa Indonesia.
  • Launches in emerging markets.
  • Gold, remittances, or card products.

What we offer

  • Ownership from day one. High-trust, high-ownership culture where you get room to act like an owner and the support to raise the bar.
  • Competitive pay, benchmarked across our markets and reviewed as you grow.
  • A real path forward through Grow with Fasset (#GwF), our L1–L7 progression framework with both IC and Manager tracks.
  • Global exposure working alongside a team spread across seven markets, solving problems that matter for emerging economies.
  • Learning and development support to keep growing your craft.

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Enterprise Risk

Risk at Gemini is a team dedicated to managing the next generation of financial and non-financial risks in a complex and evolving landscape. We are a diverse group of technology, legal, and operational professionals who develop new approaches to solving classic problems using cutting edge tools and processes in an ever changing industry. We are looking for like-minded individuals who are willing to be bold, visionaries and live the ethos of turning risk into return for our shareholders.

The Role: Senior Associate, Risk Analytics

Gemini is seeking an Sr. Associate, Risk Analytics to join the Risk Management function. As we evolve our risk infrastructure, we are looking for a quantitative and technically proficient individual to move our risk management from reactive, manual processes to a proactive, automated, and agentic model. This role will own the design and implementation of systems for continuous control monitoring, using agentic AI to detect, escalate, and remediate risk across the entire enterprise. 

You will work closely with Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Operations to build the "risk brain" of the company—an environment where risk controls are codified, monitored in real-time, and scaled through autonomous agents.

Responsibilities

  • Continuous Control Monitoring
    • Lead the design and implementation of an automated, continuous monitoring framework that spans all enterprise risk domains (Credit, Fraud, Operational, Compliance). Move the firm away from periodic/manual checks toward real-time observability. 
  • Agentic Risk Infrastructure 
    • Scale our risk management capabilities by developing and deploying AI agents to monitor control activities. Orchestrate agentic workflows to perform proactive anomaly detection, perform root-cause analysis on incidents, and suggest risk mitigation actions. 
  • Enterprise Risk Analytics 
    • Interpret large, complex datasets to formulate problem statements and generate insights across all business verticals. Develop predictive models and detection tools that reduce risk exposure and enhance operational efficiency. 
  • Risk Governance & Reporting 
    • Maintain a comprehensive view of the AI and model risk inventory. Develop automated dashboards that provide senior management with a "solid analytical story," leveraging BI tools to track Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) against appetite. 
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration 
    • Partner with the Risk Engineering, Identity, and Product teams to ensure risk telemetry is properly instrumented. Provide clear communication and training on how to interpret agentic outputs and maintain human-in-the-loop oversight.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Finance, Engineering). 
  • 3–5 years of experience in risk management, analytics, or a related technical domain.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong SQL and relational database skills; intermediate-to-advanced Python ability. 
  • AI/Agentic Frameworks: Demonstrated experience or strong familiarity with building or deploying AI agents (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, or similar orchestration frameworks) and large language model integration. 
  • Continuous Monitoring: Experience designing or maintaining automated systems for data quality, observability, or control monitoring. 
  • Data Communication: Ability to translate complex data and AI output into clear, actionable reporting for senior stakeholders. 
  • Mindset: A "no-task-is-too-small" attitude, combined with the ability to operate in ambiguity and a healthy balance of empathy and skepticism toward automated systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Business Intelligence and Data Visualization (Tableau, Looker).
  • Prior experience in model risk management (MRM) and knowledge of MAS AI MRM supervisory expectations. 
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock, GCP and opensource LLMS. 
  • Experience in MLOps or AIOps (e.g., CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML models).
It Pays to Work Here
 
The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:
  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $99,400 - $142,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Software Engineer or Senior Software Engineer to join the OEX Mobile Growth team in Singapore.

The team operates at the intersection of mobile engineering, consumer growth, and product development. You will work closely with Product, Business Development, and regional market teams to build and improve growth initiatives that directly influence user acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention.

This role is suited to an engineer who enjoys solving user-facing problems, working with data, and contributing ideas beyond implementation. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of projects from problem definition through launch, measurement, and iteration.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, test, and maintain reliable mobile growth features and supporting systems.
  • Contribute across the full engineering lifecycle, from understanding business and user problems to implementation, launch, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Develop and optimise growth capabilities such as onboarding funnels, referral programmes, acquisition journeys, engagement mechanics, notifications, and experimentation frameworks.
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Business Development, data teams, and regional stakeholders to translate growth objectives into practical engineering solutions.
  • Instrument user journeys and analyse relevant metrics to identify friction points and improvement opportunities.
  • Participate in technical discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and contribute proposals based on engineering principles, user impact, and data.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and problem-solving.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code while contributing to code reviews and engineering best practices.
  • For senior-level hires, independently lead projects, guide technical decisions, and support the development of other engineers.

What We Look For In You

  • At least 3 years of software engineering experience, with greater depth and independent project ownership expected at the Senior Software Engineer level.
  • Hands-on experience developing production mobile applications using iOS technologies such as Swift or Objective-C, or Android technologies such as Kotlin or Java.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, system design, testing, debugging, and performance optimisation.
  • Experience building consumer-facing products, with an understanding of how engineering decisions affect user experience and business outcomes.
  • Product and data instincts: you are comfortable thinking in terms of user journeys, funnels, conversion, retention, and measurable impact.
  • Ability to take ownership of engineering tasks and work effectively with product and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive and solution-oriented mindset: you identify problems, form a point of view, and propose practical ways forward.
  • Experience using AI coding tools as part of your development workflow, together with the judgment to review, test, and validate AI-generated outputs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.

Nice-To-Haves

  • Mobile development experience in iOS (Swift/Objective-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) — or backend experience building growth systems that serve mobile apps directly (e.g. growth APIs, attribution pipelines, notification infrastructure).
  • Depth in mobile attribution and MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, SKAdNetwork).
  • ASO operational experience (App Store Connect, Google Play Console).
  • Experience building referral systems, k-factor mechanics, or anti-fraud layers.
  • Background in fintech, crypto, or regulated consumer financial products.
  • Experience operating across US, EEA, and APAC markets.
  • A/B experiment framework ownership at meaningful scale.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

descriptions.job-00d0xz4:
At GoMining, a General Manager is the end-to-end owner of a business direction, responsible for its strategy, P&L, product, team, and overall results. A GM combines business, product, and operational ownership — setting priorities, managing unit economics, driving execution, and making decisions based on data. The goal is to run the direction as a business and take full responsibility for its growth, profitability, and performance.

We are looking for a General Manager to own the platform that powers the GoMining ecosystem.

The Platform team builds and operates the shared foundation used by multiple GoMining products — core application infrastructure, authentication, integrations, analytics events, user restrictions, native applications, design systems, reliability, and other shared services.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, product, and business.

You will need to balance long-term platform investments in reliability, architecture, and security with high-priority business requests where a relatively small technical change can directly unlock revenue.

This is not a pure infrastructure or engineering management role. You will own the Platform direction end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, metrics, team, and its impact on the wider business.


Responsibilities

Platform Ownership

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for the GoMining platform.
  • Build a scalable shared platform used by multiple product teams.
  • Identify which capabilities should be centralized and which should remain within individual product teams.
  • Prioritize platform investments based on technical risk and business impact.
  • Work directly with product General Managers and C-level stakeholders.
  • Ensure the platform enables product teams to move faster rather than becoming a bottleneck.

Reliability & Infrastructure

  • Own platform uptime, availability, latency, and reliability.
  • Define and track SLAs and operational performance.
  • Own incident management and post-incident improvements.
  • Improve release stability and engineering performance.
  • Track and improve DORA metrics.
  • Identify technical bottlenecks before they become business-critical problems.

Shared Product Infrastructure

  • Own shared authentication and registration infrastructure.
  • Develop unified authorization and 2FA capabilities.
  • Build common mechanisms for user restrictions and account-level controls.
  • Support integrations required by different GoMining products.
  • Own shared analytics events and related platform capabilities.
  • Support native applications and common product infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain shared design-system capabilities together with Product and Design.

Business Enablement

  • Work closely with other business lines to understand their platform dependencies.
  • Handle high-priority requests where integrations, events, admin functionality, or other platform changes directly affect revenue or customer experience.
  • Balance urgent commercial requests against long-term technical and security priorities.
  • Create transparent prioritization mechanisms across competing internal stakeholders.
  • Measure Platform not only by technical performance but also by its ability to accelerate the rest of the company.

Security

  • Ensure security is built into platform architecture and engineering processes.
  • Work closely with Security, Risk, and other relevant teams.
  • Own platform-level security initiatives within the agreed scope.
  • Improve authentication, authorization, access controls, and platform resilience.

AI-First Engineering

  • Personally use AI tools and agents in day-to-day work.
  • Introduce AI-assisted workflows across engineering, specifications, analytics, QA, and operational processes.
  • Identify areas where AI can reduce repetitive work and increase engineering velocity.
  • Build a team where AI is part of the operating model rather than an occasional tool.

Team & Delivery

  • Lead the engineering team together with the Tech Lead.
  • Own priorities, backlog, releases, incidents, and delivery.
  • Set clear technical and business metrics.
  • Hire, develop, and manage team performance.
  • Maintain a high execution speed with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Strong experience leading platform, infrastructure, or platform engineering teams.
  • Experience building shared infrastructure used by multiple products or engineering teams.
  • Hands-on understanding of uptime, reliability, incidents, security, and high-load systems.
  • Strong understanding of platform architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with authentication, authorization, shared services, or similar platform capabilities.
  • Ability to balance technical priorities with immediate business needs.
  • Strong product and commercial mindset.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both engineers and business leaders.
  • Experience managing engineering teams and delivery.
  • Strong data-driven approach.
  • Real hands-on use of AI tools and agents.
  • Experience in fintech, crypto, gaming, hosting, or another high-load technology environment is highly relevant.
  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote or hybrid format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days +  8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year
  • Recognition programs: structured performance reviews and team awards.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).

会社紹介

Startale Groupは「世界をオンチェーン化することで、次の文明を創る」をミッションに掲げる、オンチェーン金融領域の日本発グローバルスタートアップです。Sony・SBIなどからシリーズAで約100億円を調達し、チェーン、ステーブルコイン、決済、アプリまでを垂直統合で提供しています。

このポジションについて

Startaleのオンチェーン金融事業を、ビジネスサイドから前に進めるポジションです。ビジネス全般の受け皿として、社内外を巻き込む案件のプロジェクトマネジメントを軸に、事業開発までを担っていただきます。

扱う対象は固定していません。日本円ステーブルコイン「JPYSC」、L1ブロックチェーン「Strium」、新規のオンチェーン金融プロダクトなど、その時点で会社が最も前に進めたい案件に入っていただきます。領域が動くことを前提とした役割です。

仕事内容

  • パートナー案件のプロジェクトマネジメント。社内外を巻き込んだ遂行と案件管理
  • 論点整理、要件の言語化、関係者の合意形成、進行と納期の管理
  • 事業開発。機会創出から関係構築・提案・契約まで
  • 顧客・パートナーのニーズを、プロダクトの要件へ翻訳
  • 事業として成立するスキーム・座組みの設計
  • 東京・ニューヨーク・シンガポールのグローバルチームとの協業

必須要件

  • 社会人経験5年以上
  • 日本語ネイティブレベル。英語でのコミュニケーションが可能なこと
  • 複数の関係者が関わる仕事を、自分で完了まで持っていったご経験（領域・職種は問いません）
  • 変化の速い環境を面白がれること

歓迎要件

  • コンサルティングファームでのプロジェクトデリバリーのご経験。金融機関向け案件のご経験があればとくに歓迎します
  • 金融機関（銀行・証券など）でのご実務経験
  • 大手Tech企業でのプロジェクトマネジメント、またはPMOのご経験。金融業界担当のご経験があればとくに歓迎します
  • 金融機関向けのクライアント営業・事業開発のご経験、または大手金融機関とのネットワーク
  • 証券会社などでの商品組成のご経験
  • プラットフォーム側（AWS/Azure 等）での決済系プロジェクトのご経験
  • ブロックチェーン・デジタルアセットへの関心・知見

求める人物像

  1. 士魂商才 - 世界で本気で勝ちにいく気概と、誇れるやり方を両立できる方
  2. オーナーシップ - 前例のない環境でも自ら優先順位を決め、成果に責任を持てる方
  3. 地頭とやり切る力 - 知識の量ではなく、初めての論点でも筋を立てて前に進められる方
  4. 素直さとアンラーン - 変化を面白がり、学び直せる方
  5. グローバルマインドセット - 難しい環境でもアグレッシブに動ける方

  • ストックオプション：入社後(試用期間後)、当社規程に基づき付与します。選考の過程で、付与株数・行使価格・直近ラウンドの評価額を開示してご説明します

Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. As an intern, you are paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world projects we actually need done.

You will see how we develop and execute requests for proposal (RFPs), negotiate with vendors, level disparate quotes, manage inventory, raise purchase orders, handle global logistics, and analyze spend data.

Your internship project might focus on finding and implementing ways to improve efficiency in our internal processes, or helping us to plan and research our sourcing efforts. Your mentors will come from different areas of the team, so you’ll gain a better understanding of the planning, execution, and problem solving required pre-purchase and post-purchase. Your daily project work will be complemented by lunch seminars, real-time discussion on the desk, and classes that give you a sense of the broader fundamentals of Jane Street’s business and how your daily work fits into the big picture of our firm.

Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here.

descriptions.job-0mbw4qo:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together. So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale. Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

About the role

Channel Sales Support Agent About the role The Channel Sales Support Agent is the operational backbone for our independent contractor (IC) sales teams in the field. You'll be their go-to person—making sure they have everything they need to successfully sell and onboard our products to local sellers across Europe. This isn't just a support role. You're enabling entrepreneurs to build their businesses, and their success is your success. Who you are You're someone who:

  • Thrives in fast-paced environments – You stay calm when things move quickly and priorities shift
  • Genuinely enjoys helping others succeed – You get satisfaction from unblocking problems and empowering people
  • Takes ownership – When you pick up a problem, you see it through to resolution
  • Shows up consistently – Your team knows they can count on you, every time
  • Takes initiative – You spot issues before they're escalated and act without being asked
  • Understands partnership – When your contractors win, you win
  • Brings positive energy – You're professional, approachable, and a pleasure to work with

What you'll be doing Support & relationship building

  • Act as the main point of contact for Europe sales teams, responding to inquiries within agreed SLA timeframes
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with independent contractor sales teams
  • Provide product knowledge, pricing information, sales collateral, and technical guidance

Coordination & problem-solving

  • Work with internal teams across the business to resolve sales inefficiencies and remove blockers
  • Identify recurring problems and partner with management to implement lasting solutions
  • Provide phone and face-to-face support when needed

Operations & administration

  • Maintain and update sales documentation, playbooks, and resource libraries
  • Process commission calculations for Europe sales teams in coordination with finance
  • Keep systems and information current so teams always have what they need

Your experience Required:

  • 1–2 years in sales support, channel management, technical support/implementation, or customer service
  • Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and AI tools
  • Familiarity with B2B sales processes and sales cycle management
  • Basic understanding of sales reporting and analytics

Preferred:

  • Experience working with self-employed contractors, distributors, sellers, or channel partners
  • Bilingual in English/French

Work environment & conditions

  • Location: Remote-first (office optional)
  • Hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM (flexibility may be required)
  • Travel: Minimal (occasional attendance at sales meetings, training sessions, and contractor events)
  • Equipment: Computer, headset, and necessary software provided

Why this role matters Our independent contractors are out there every day, building relationships and helping local businesses grow. You're the person who makes sure they're never stuck, never without answers, and always set up to succeed. If you love being the reliable force behind a winning team, this role is for you.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or NYC Office (or Remote from GMT -4 up to +2 GMT)

Role

As Morpho grows, we want to keep the way we operate simple: give managers and team members the tools to make good people decisions themselves and be more autonomous and effective, rather than building a large HR function around them. You will help build the People infrastructure that makes this possible.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of People, operations and product thinking. You will own People products end-to-end — from understanding where managers or team members are struggling, to designing a solution, rolling it out and improving it based on feedback. This can range from making onboarding work seamlessly across teams and geographies, to improving how we manage compensation, People data or internal tools.

Responsibilities

  • Own People products and projects from problem identification to rollout and iteration

  • Speak regularly with managers and ICs to understand recurring friction and where People infrastructure is not working well enough

  • Turn recurring questions and manual work into clearer tools, better workflows or automation

  • Improve onboarding so new joiners, managers and other owners know what to do without constant coordination from People

  • Help improve performance, feedback, promotion and career processes as Morpho scales

  • Build and maintain the compensation infrastructure: market data, principles and decision tools that help managers and leadership make good decisions

  • Make People information easy to find, understand and use

  • Use AI and automation wherever they can reduce repetitive work or improve the user experience

  • Support sensitive People situations when specific judgment, trust or independence is needed

  • Take on new People infrastructure problems where they can create the most leverage across the organization

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand how Morpho operates and how the People team works. You have spoken with managers and ICs about their main People friction, run your first People projects and identified where the current infrastructure is creating unnecessary manual work or dependency.

First 3 months

You own several People products end-to-end and are improving them based on user feedback. Eg: Onboarding works with limited coordination from People. Common People questions are easier to answer without a manual request. At least one recurring source of friction has been turned into a better tool, workflow or automation.

First 6 months

Managers and ICs are more autonomous because of the People infrastructure you built. The People products you own are simple, trusted and easy to use. Recurring manual work has decreased. You have shipped meaningful improvements across several areas such as onboarding, performance, compensation, career development or manager tooling.

Must Have Skills & Experience

  • Strong analytical and modelling skills, comfortable with numbers

  • Strong ownership and autonomy

  • Low ego

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.
